name: isDomainAdminWorkstationLogonDenied
definition: True when every enabled workstation is covered by an enabled, unfiltered GPO that denies Domain Admins both local logon and Remote Desktop Services logon.
population: enabled workstation computer accounts of one AD domain (domain controllers and servers excluded); denominator = enabled workstations
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete GPO read plus the workstation OU inheritance picture showing 100% of enabled workstations covered by a GPO denying <domainSid>-512 SeDenyInteractiveLogonRight and SeDenyRemoteInteractiveLogonRight.

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real-tenant body replayed yet, so V0).
